cohort: The cohort consisted of 96 neonates admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) of a teaching tertiary care hospital.
finding: Low birth weight is a major source of morbidity, and premature delivery and sepsis are the main causes of neonatal mortality in the NICU.
mod_finding: LSCS constituted the predominant mode of delivery, accounting for 58.3% of cases.
birth_weight: All birth weights, with specific focus on low birth weight (<2.5 kg)
